description: This file defines a Bootstrap carousel component, including the Carousel class, its methods, plugin definition, and data API for initializing carousels.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: A class managing the behavior of Bootstrap's carousel component, including slide transitions, cycling, pausing, and navigation.

methods.name: cycle
methods.description: Starts the automatic cycling of the carousel based on the interval option.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Navigates the carousel to a specific slide position.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the carousel to the next slide.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Moves the carousel to the previous slide.

methods.name: slide
methods.description: Handles the transition to a specified slide, with support for CSS transitions.
